articles.title: Anh Do: ‘When your mum believes in you, you’ve got no option but to make sure you succeed’
articles.summary: The standup comedian, writer and artist on what made him stop doing art, and the tragedy that prompted him to pick up a paintbrush again. Sign up for a weekly email featuring our best reads. Most Tafe students are fresh out of high school.
body: “This 18-year-old bloke comes up to me and goes, ‘Geez, you look like Anh Do.’ I said, ‘Yeah, that’s because I am.’ And he goes, ‘Nah, you’re not, but you bloody look like him,’ and walks off,” Do says. He eventually convinced the teenager that he was, in fact, the real Anh Do – and a friendship was born. “I’m still mates with him now!”

I believe him – within a few minutes of meeting Do, now 49, it’s clear he is one of those people with the preternatural ability to befriend anyone. Standing at our meeting spot outside a large converted warehouse in the Sydney suburb of Newtown, Do spots me first – he cartoonishly swivels around, erupts with an oversized wave and tells me how excited he is for our chat. He then launches into jovial, mile-a-minute conversation before I can even clip his mic on. Do is full of anecdotes like his Tafe run-in – some of which are written on the palm of his hand, so he doesn’t forget to bring them up (“I’m just going to give you my best stories, and you put in whatever you want to!”).
points: The standup comedian, writer and artist on what made him stop doing art, and the tragedy that prompted him to pick up a paintbrush again.

articles.title: Models Off-Duty Love a Salmon Sneaker—Black Friday 2026 Lets You Get a Pair for Less
articles.summary: It’s no secret the model off-duty set loves a comfy shoe, with Salomon sneakers being one of their top choices—get a pair for less this Black Friday.
body: You don’t need us to tell you that Salomon sneakers are perfect for low-key weekend looks. You will, however, appreciate us scoping out a few on sale this Black Friday.

For years, Salomon’s rugged trail hikers were reserved for outdoorsy pursuits; they’ve become mainstays in a modern everyday wardrobe (particularly those of models off-duty ) for a few reasons, chief among them their sporty look, which signals a cool readiness for whatever the day may bring. It certainly helps, too, that the shoe’s main design features—a grippy sole, a waterproof upper, and a quick-lace system—all allow for easy, versatile wear no matter the weather.

But it’s not just models who love this particular sneaker: designer Jonathan Anderson has made Salomon sneakers an integral part of his uniform, which typically consists of straight-leg Levi’s, a simple crew-neck sweater—often in navy blue or green—and a white T-shirt peeking out just below the collar. (When Anderson’s not in a knit, you can find him in a plaid button-down.) Many stylish A-listers—including Emily Ratajkowski, Kendall Jenner, and Jennifer Lawrence—have also sported the shoe on off-duty days.
